item.description:

efetch_medline, download_crossref and download_arxiv looped over range(retries),

UnboundLocalError on `data`, and the other two returned nothing. Use
max(1, retries) attempts. Adds tests for a successful and a failing download.

item.description:
fix(nature-figure): report OpenRouter timeouts and image download failures cleanly

request_images only caught HTTPError and URLError, so a socket timeout while
waiting for headers or reading the body escaped as a raw TimeoutError traceback
after the request had already been sent (and billed). The second urlopen that
fetches item["url"] had no handler at all. Catch OSError/TimeoutError for both
and exit with a clear message. Adds tests.

item.title: fix(nature-response): resolve \input of a dotted filename like sec1.f…
item.description:
fix(nature-response): resolve \input of a dotted filename like sec1.final

check_package_consistency appended ".tex" only when the target had no suffix, so
\input{sec1.final} (a file named sec1.final.tex) looked for "sec1.final", failed
is_file(), and the include was left unexpanded; the checker then silently skipped
that section's text. Follow LaTeX: try name.tex first, then the literal name.
Adds tests, including explicit .tex and extensionless existing files.

item.title: fix: match a top-level --output path in the star-history README cache…
item.description:
fix: match a top-level --output path in the star-history README cache-buster

For `--output star-history.svg` PurePosixPath(...).parent is ".", so the pattern
required a literal "./" prefix and matched nothing: the SVG was written, then
update_readme_cache_buster raised RuntimeError and left the README stale.
Omit the directory prefix for a top-level file and anchor the match so it does
not rewrite a longer filename such as other-star-history.svg. Adds tests.

item.title: fix: leave the star-history chart unchanged when stargazer counts dis…
item.description:
fix: leave the star-history chart unchanged when stargazer counts disagree

fetch_stargazers raised StarHistoryUnavailable ("leaving the existing chart
unchanged") when GitHub's reported count and the returned timestamps differ by
more than 100, but main only caught that exception around build_daily_points, so
the job crashed with a traceback and exit 1 instead of warning and returning 0.
Catch it around the fetch too. A missing token is a configuration error, so it
now raises a StarHistoryAuthRequired subclass that still fails the job. Adds tests.

item.title: fix(nature-downloader): require an open licence before calling an art…
item.description:
fix(nature-downloader): require an open licence before calling an article OA

confirmedOa and the publisher_oa candidate treated any Crossref licence URL as
proof of open access, but paywalled articles routinely carry publisher TDM or
user licences (for example elsevier.com/tdm/userlicense/1.0), so a subscription
article was reported as "confirmed_oa" even when Unpaywall said it was closed.

tests for the TDM case and the CC URL case.

item.title: fix(nature-downloader): do not overwrite a saved paper that has the s…
item.description:
fix(nature-downloader): do not overwrite a saved paper that has the same title

saveFullTextResponse named the file from the title (or DOI, or the literal
"article" fallback) and renameSync replaced any existing file, so a second paper
with the same title ("Editorial"), or any two direct --pdf-url downloads
without a title, silently destroyed the first and left the manifest sha256 for
it pointing at the wrong bytes. Add -2, -3, ... when the existing file has
different content, and reuse the file when the bytes are identical. Adds tests.

item.title: fix(nature-image2ppt): keep source-size slides within PowerPoint's 56…
item.description:
fix(nature-image2ppt): keep source-size slides within PowerPoint's 56 in limit

source_size_slide divided pixels by a fixed 96, so a 6000x3000 image produced a
62.5 in wide <p:sldSz> that PowerPoint rejects (its maximum is 56 in per side).
Use a coarser px/inch when either side would exceed 56 in, keeping the aspect
ratio and recording the px_per_inch actually used. Adds tests.

item.title: fix(nature-image2ppt): resolve package-absolute OPC relationship targets
item.description:
fix(nature-image2ppt): resolve package-absolute OPC relationship targets

posixpath.join("ppt", "/ppt/slides/slide1.xml") returns the absolute path
unchanged, so a relationship Target written as "/ppt/..." (valid OPC) no longer
matched any zip member: the slide read raised KeyError (not caught as the
ValueError normalize_inputs expects) and image parts were reported missing even
though they were present. Add join_part() that treats a leading "/" as the
package root and use it for resolve_target and both slide-part joins. Adds
tests.

item.title: fix(nature-image2ppt): flatten transparent images onto white, not black
item.description:
fix(nature-image2ppt): flatten transparent images onto white, not black

save_image_page and extract_image_based_pptx_pages used convert("RGB"), which
drops alpha and exposes the colour stored under transparent pixels (normally
black), so a PNG with a transparent background became a black slide
background. Composite RGBA/LA/palette-with-transparency images onto white
first. Adds tests, including partial alpha and opaque pixels unchanged.

Xinrui Ma
item.label: commit

item.title: fix(nature-image2ppt): never delete an existing --keep-workdir directory
item.description:
fix(nature-image2ppt): never delete an existing --keep-workdir directory

_maybe_keep_workdir called shutil.rmtree on the target whenever it existed, so
`formula render-latex --keep-workdir assets` (accepted because assets/ is inside
the page directory) deleted every image in the page's assets folder before
copying the TeX debug files in. Refuse an existing non-empty target that was not
written by this command (marker file), check it before rendering so it cannot
mask a LaTeX error, and still replace its own previous copy. Adds tests.

Xinrui Ma
item.label: commit

item.title: fix: ignore code-fenced "##" lines in update-reference-tocs.py
item.description:
fix: ignore code-fenced "##" lines in update-reference-tocs.py

The heading scan matched any "## " line, including shell comments inside fenced
code blocks, so a long reference containing such a block got a bogus Contents
entry. Track fence state and skip headings inside it. Adds a test.

feat(nature-paper-xray): 新增单篇论文精读技能

新增 `nature-paper-xray`：把一篇给定论文读到能复述作者的推理，而不是复述摘要。

它做四件事：

- 还原作者真实的出发点——这一步要解决前人的哪个具体问题；论文没讲就写论文没讲，不替作者编动机
- 分清承重与装饰——这个设计拿掉会塌，还是顺手加的；有消融或附录能判断就指出来，没有就写论文没做这个对照
- 公式落到能手算的例子——每个符号给形状和含义，关键公式后面跟一个微型例子，写具体数字算到底
- 核对证据边界——正文数字与图表是否一致、基线对照条件是否对齐、超参是否只在测试集上挑、有没有预处理泄漏、代价与结论失效的条件

划界：只读不判。它报告论文做了什么、证据够到哪儿，不评分、不排名、不判录用成熟度或新颖性
（那是 nature-reviewer）；不提炼写作范式、不翻译、不检索文献、不核验引用、不代写正文。

- `SKILL.md`——立场、工作流、按论文类型调整阅读重心、边界、输出规范
- `references/deep-reading-protocol.md`——精读顺序、能手算例子的标准、承重判定、交付物结构与失败模式

feat(nature-paper-xray): 新增单篇论文精读技能

新增 `nature-paper-xray`：把一篇给定论文读到能复述作者的推理，而不是复述摘要。

它做四件事：

- 还原作者真实的出发点——这一步要解决前人的哪个具体问题；论文没讲就写论文没讲，不替作者编动机
- 分清承重与装饰——这个设计拿掉会塌，还是顺手加的；有消融或附录能判断就指出来，没有就写论文没做这个对照
- 公式落到能手算的例子——每个符号给形状和含义，关键公式后面跟一个微型例子，写具体数字算到底
- 核对证据边界——正文数字与图表是否一致、基线对照条件是否对齐、超参是否只在测试集上挑、有没有预处理泄漏、代价与结论失效的条件

划界：只读不判。它报告论文做了什么、证据够到哪儿，不评分、不排名、不判录用成熟度或新颖性
（那是 nature-reviewer）；不提炼写作范式、不翻译、不检索文献、不核验引用、不代写正文。

文件：

- `SKILL.md`——立场、工作流、按论文类型调整阅读重心、边界、输出规范
- `references/deep-reading-protocol.md`——精读顺序、能手算例子的标准、承重判定、交付物结构与失败模式
- `references/evidence-boundary.md`——数字一致性、基线对齐、选择压力、泄漏、代价与范围、缺口如何如实写、严重度分级
- `README.md` / `README_EN.md`——中英镜像，六个基础章节
- `manifest.yaml`、`agents/openai.yaml`

item.description:
feat(nature-paper-xray): 新增单篇论文精读技能

新增 `nature-paper-xray`：把一篇给定论文读到能复述作者的推理，而不是复述摘要。

它做四件事：

- 还原作者真实的出发点——这一步要解决前人的哪个具体问题；论文没讲就写论文没讲，不替作者编动机
- 分清承重与装饰——这个设计拿掉会塌，还是顺手加的；有消融或附录能判断就指出来，没有就写论文没做这个对照
- 公式落到能手算的例子——每个符号给形状和含义，关键公式后面跟一个微型例子，写具体数字算到底
- 核对证据边界——正文数字与图表是否一致、基线对照条件是否对齐、超参是否只在测试集上挑、有没有预处理泄漏、代价与结论失效的条件

划界：只读不判。它报告论文做了什么、证据够到哪儿，不评分、不排名、不判录用成熟度或新颖性
（那是 nature-reviewer）；不提炼写作范式、不翻译、不检索文献、不核验引用、不代写正文。

文件：

- `SKILL.md`——立场、工作流、按论文类型调整阅读重心、边界、输出规范
- `references/deep-reading-protocol.md`——精读顺序、能手算例子的标准、承重判定、交付物结构与失败模式
- `references/evidence-boundary.md`——数字一致性、基线对齐、选择压力、泄漏、代价与范围、缺口如何如实写、严重度分级
- `README.md` / `README_EN.md`——中英镜像，六个基础章节
- `manifest.yaml`、`agents/openai.yaml`
